description.value: Innocent Ice Cream is a family-run, gluten-free ice cream sandwich shop in Vancouver's Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood, founded in 2014 after the owner spent years perfecting celiac-safe cookie recipes. The shop crafts hand-made ice cream sandwiches, milkshakes, cones, and soda floats entirely in-store year-round, with plant-based and non-dairy options available. Beyond the storefront, Innocent also operates a solar-powered ice cream truck and a pink tricycle for catering events across the city.
